title: Flat-ground OnBoard locomotion graph
scope: 120 Hz flat-ground rolling and speed-sensitive carve physics
regular and mongo hard-push tap/hold state sequencing
moving footbrake lead-in, cycle, moving-out, transition-to-stand, stand-cycle, and stand-out
frontside and backside powerslide input gate, reduced lateral grip, deceleration, spin, and 000/090/180 out leaves
retail board, truck, and wheel hierarchy with rolling wheel spin and grounded truck counter-articulation
animated OnBoard toe-target preservation and post-animation two-leg IK
deterministic fixed-input replay and owner visual checkpoint

retail_evidence.claim: Grounded OnBoard hierarchy, Turning/Idle behavior order, BTREE_RIDING blend time, Still speed threshold, and three-second Random transition.
PushStart, sequence CYC1/CYC2, repeat path, PushEnd transition type, blend durations, and WillExpire windows.
Moving and stationary brake state topology, 0.15 speed split, animation leaves, 0.2-second blends, and expiry windows.
Frontside slide Into/Cyc/Out graph, PowerSlideDecel and PowerSlideSpin behavior placement, minimum 0.3-second parent time, and 0.2/0.1-second blend times.
Backside slide mirror graph and left-slide behavior mapping.
Stationary random-idle animation leaves and input-driven exit.

Matched retail fixtures establish 1.18 m/s push impulse, 0.035 rolling drag, speed-sensitive carve coefficients, 0.22-second brake lead-in, 3.90 m/s^2 brake deceleration, steep-diagonal powerslide gate, approximately 0.5 m/s^2 slide deceleration, and approximately 0.9 m/s slide cutoff.
Authoritative OnBoard skeleton animation database used for every scoped animation leaf.
Authoritative source frame counts and native sample rates for scoped push, brake, powerslide, riding, and random-idle leaves.
RX2/ABIN conversion, full-skeleton pose matrices, skinned mesh deformation, board root-motion lock, and OnBoard toe-target reconstruction are numerically validated against the source.

required_observations: Neutral riding places both feet and the character mass correctly over the retail board.
A tapped hard push reads as one complete whole-body push; a held push repeats contact/cycle without replaying Into.
Carving blends progressively through the extracted HCOM leaves while the deck leans and all wheel contacts remain grounded.
Footbrake uses the full moving brake pose, begins meaningful deceleration after the lead-in, transitions into the standing brake at a stop, and exits cleanly.
Only a steep down/side left-stick diagonal enters a powerslide; pure side and 45-degree diagonal inputs remain carves.
The frontside/backside powerslide and 000/090/180 out transitions read as the extracted retail motion without a pose snap.
After three seconds stationary with no input, the extracted long stationary idle plays with both feet registered.

human_checks: Tap Space once from rest, then hold Space through two pushes and release. Check for the full torso/arm movement and no ghost loop.
Push once, hold A and then D separately. Check progressive left/right HCOM blending, correct deck lean direction, level spinning wheels, and planted tyres.
While rolling, hold B through a complete stop, keep holding briefly, then release. Check moving brake, transition-to-stand, stand-cycle, and stand-out.
Push once, then hold S+D. Repeat with S+A. Check frontside/backside powerslide entry and release; verify A/D alone and an approximately 45-degree diagonal do not slide.
Press R, release every input, and wait just over three seconds. Check the long stationary idle and foot/board registration.
Repeat carve, brake, and powerslide once with a controller using Xbox A, B, and the left stick.
known_scoped_unknowns: ApplyingBodyTilt's update order is recovered, but body_tilt_ground_clamp_vel and body_tilt_ground_clamp_acc live attribute values are not present in the static snapshot; the current values remain explicitly calibrated candidates.
SetTurning::Reshape is recovered as vectorized executable math, but its complete runtime attribute inputs and final animation-channel matrices still need a matched retail matrix capture.
The exact LSP/HSP animation-selector boundary is unresolved; 4.25 m/s currently changes authored pose selection only and does not affect physics.

Powerslide earlyout/midout animation-attribute windows and the exact PowerSlideSpin 000/090/180 selector need a retail attribute trace; the current out leaf is selected by the nearest recovered authored rotation family.
Difficulty, truck tightness, wheel hardness, surface material, slopes, pumping, kickturn/revert, switch stance, and camera behavior are not part of this flat-ground checkpoint.
